sloka: नर्मदापुलिने यत्र राक्षसेन्द्रः सुदारुणः ।पुष्पोपहारं कुरुते तस्माद्देशाददूरतः ।। ७.३२.१ ॥
transliteration: narmadāpuline yatra rākṣasendraḥ sudāruṇaḥ ।puṣpopahāraṁ kurute tasmāddeśādadūrataḥ ।। 7.32.1 ॥

translations.english: Not far from the place on the Narmada's sandbank where the very fierce lord of Rakshasas (Ravana) was performing his flower offering, another event was unfolding.
